originalTitle: Australia keep faith in Marnus Labuschagne as Test squad for South Africa tour named
summary: The under-pressure batter has been included on a 16-man list for the three-Test series in Durban, Gqeberha and Cape Town
content: Australian selectors have stuck with struggling batter Marnus Labuschagne for next month’s Test tour of South Africa. Sixteen players were named on Monday, including all those involved in the most recent defeat of Bangladesh in Mackay. Fast bowler Michael Neser, spinner Matthew Kuhnemann and batter Cooper Connolly will join the group for the series starting in Durban on 9 October. Labuschagne was ICC’s top-ranked Test batter in 2023, but has struggled for runs in the years since with his last century coming in the 2023 Ashes. He averaged 25 in last summer’s Ashes, and then had scores of 1, 31 and 4 in the recent Tests against Bangladesh. The 32-year-old will be competing with Josh Inglis and Connolly, the 23-year-old who has been tipped for a bright future. Connolly has played one Test for Australia last year in Sri Lanka, as well as matches in T20 and ODI formats. He will be in South Africa for the ODI series prior to the Tests in a squad named last week notable for its omission of Labuschagne. Connolly scored 216 runs at an average of 31 for Western Australia in the Sheffield Shield last season, but has a solid first class record. Over 13 matches, the middle-order batter averages 42. Chair of selectors George Bailey said the squad provides options for the tightly-scheduled tour, which marks the start of a busy summer for Australia, before red ball series with New Zealand and India. “This is a reasonably condensed three-game series, on the back of six one-day internationals, with only short breaks between each game,” he said. “The squad provides balance and options for each Test and the variety of conditions we may face.” Australia squad: Pat Cummins (captain), Scott Boland, Alex Carey, Cooper Connolly, Cameron Green, Josh Hazlewood, Travis Head, Josh Inglis, Matthew Kuhnemann, Marnus Labuschagne, Nathan Lyon, Michael Neser, Matthew Renshaw, Steve Smith, Mitchell Starc, Beau Webster.
chineseTitle: 澳大利亚对马努斯·拉布沙涅 (Marnus Labuschagne) 充满信心，任命为南非巡回赛测试队
chineseSummary: 这位承受压力的击球手已被列入德班、格克贝哈和开普敦三场测试系列赛的 16 人名单中
chineseContent: 澳大利亚选拔者选择了苦苦挣扎的击球手马努斯·拉布沙涅 (Marnus Labuschagne) 参加下个月的南非测试之旅。周一，十六名球员被提名，其中包括最近在麦凯击败孟加拉国队的所有球员。快速投球手迈克尔·内瑟 (Michael Neser)、旋转手马修·库尼曼 (Matthew Kuhnemann) 和击球手库珀·康诺利 (Cooper Connolly) 将与球队一起参加 10 月 9 日在德班开始的系列赛。拉布沙涅是 2023 年 ICC 测试排名最高的击球手，但自那以后的几年里，他的得分一直在挣扎，他的上个世纪是在 2023 年灰烬杯中打出的。去年夏天的灰烬杯比赛中，他场均得分为25分，而在最近对阵孟加拉国的测试赛中，他的得分分别是1分、31分和4分。这位 32 岁的球员将与乔什·英格利斯 (Josh Inglis) 和 23 岁的康诺利 (Connolly) 竞争，后者被认为拥有光明的未来。康诺利去年在斯里兰卡参加了一场澳大利亚测试赛，并参加了 T20 和 ODI 格式的比赛。在测试之前，他将前往南非参加 ODI 系列赛，该队上周因省略拉布沙涅而被提名。上赛季，康诺利代表西澳大利亚队在谢菲尔德盾比赛中以平均 31 分的成绩拿下 216 分，但拥有稳固的一流战绩。在 13 场比赛中，这位中级击球手平均打出 42 分。选择者主席乔治·贝利 (George Bailey) 表示，球队为日程安排紧凑的巡回赛提供了选择，这标志着澳大利亚忙碌的夏季的开始，然后是与新西兰和印度的红球系列赛。 “这是一场相当紧凑的三场系列赛，有六场为期一天的国际比赛，每场比赛之间只有短暂的休息时间，”他说。 “球队为每次测试以及我们可能面临的各种条件提供了平衡和选择。”澳大利亚队：帕特·康明斯（队长）、斯科特·博兰、亚历克斯·凯里、库珀·康诺利、卡梅伦·格林、乔什·黑兹尔伍德、特拉维斯·海德、乔什·英格利斯、马修·K
